name: Overhead Liquid Light

ui.title: LIQUID LIGHT '68
ui.tagline: Overhead glass plates and pulsing dyed oils

palette.hint: Swaps dye blends between hot psychedelic hues

viscosity.hint: Sets oil fluidity from sluggish crawl to fast rush

fringe_density.hint: Multiplies Newton ring fringes across fluid edges

plate_pressure.hint: Squeezes glass together to balloon and merge blobs

projector_vignette.hint: Frames image with circular condenser lens darkness

bubble_layer.hint: Floats jittering air bubbles trapped in the oil

listing.blurb: Saturated dyes and mineral oils squeeze and churn between glass plates on an overhead projector, swirling in real time to the bass.
listing.prompt: A 1960s liquid light show: coloured oils and water pressed between glass on an overhead projector, blobs of saturated colour swirling, merging and pulsing with the bass, projected huge behind a band. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
